aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Overview The Ontario Reign Performance Dietitian plays a vital role in providing comprehensive nutrition support for the Reign Hockey Team. The dietitian will work collaboratively with the Reign sports performance and coaching staffs in providing food service support, medical nutrition therapy, performance nutrition expertise and team nutrition education to promote optimized performance, recovery, injury management, physical development, health and wellness, and career longevity. The role will also work closely with the hockey development staff and provide nutrition support to draftees and rising players in the organization. This is a full-time position that requires evening and weekend work as well as some travel during the regular and post-season. The Ontario Reign Performance Dietitian will report to the Reign General Manager and the Los Angeles Kings Performance Dietitian. Primary Responsibilities Food Service Oversee all team meal planning, catering and travel nutrition Develop performance nutrition menus for in-house, arena, and road meals (hotels, restaurants, catering, practice facilities, etc.) Maintain detailed and accurate logs of all nutrition Collaborate with LA Kings Performance Dietitian and in-house chefs on monthly performance menus. Medical Nutrition Therapy Conduct and document comprehensive nutrition assessments for athletes and draftees Review pertinent blood labs and provide appropriate nutrition interventions Provide appropriate nutrition support for those with various medical conditions, allergies and intolerances related to food and nutrition. Performance Nutrition Counsel athletes on optimal nutrition for competition, recovery, energy balance, hydration, weight management, body composition, immunity, travel, disordered eating behaviors, and relevant supplementation Maintain inventory of all performance nutrition foods and supplements in accordance with NSF Certified for Sport and Informed Sport guidelines Prepare comprehensive player health updates for monthly performance team meetings Collect player weights and assess trends over time Provide injury recovery/surgery nutrition support Conduct DXA and sweat tests as needed over the course of the season Coordinate all nutrition planning and programming for Development Camp and Rookie Tournament Effectively communicate and work collaboratively with different departments within Reign hockey operations--coaching staff, GM, strength and conditioning coach, athletic trainers, sport psychologist, physical therapists, massage therapists and development staff Establish good rapport and connection with players and staff Nutrition Education Translate latest scientific research into practical Create monthly nutrition education teaching opportunities including cooking demonstrations, grocery store tours, food highlights, infographic creation, Qualifications Required Active Registered Dietitian credential through CDR Bache

emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:5bfa6d2b-360.title: Associate & Senior Associate, Mergers & Acquisitions
emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:5bfa6d2b-360.description: Associate / Senior Associate, M&A, Emergence Software Technologies | Hybrid, Canada | Full-Time Who We Are Emergence Software Technologies is a software-focused private equity firm investing in operationally critical software businesses in the lower middle market. We are backed by TPO, the private investment firm chaired by Jason Pritzker. Our portfolio spans auto tech, healthcare software, cloud infrastructure, and procurement, and we operate on a long-hold ownership model built for sustained value creation. The Mission Own M&A workstreams end-to-end and carry responsibility for deal outcomes across qualification, underwriting, IC, close, and post-close value creation. What You'll Do - Qualify inbound and intermediary-led opportunities against Emergence's thesis on business model fit, vertical alignment, and financial profile. - Own the financial model end-to-end including LBO structuring, operating projections, scenario analysis, and returns attribution. - Lead commercial, financial, and operational diligence workstreams and coordinate third-party advisors across QoE, legal, technology, and market. - Develop investment theses on market sizing, competitive positioning, product stickiness, and management quality, and stress-test assumptions. - Prepare and present IC materials including investment memos, deal summaries, and risk-return analyses. - Manage deal execution from LOI through close, negotiate key terms, and quarterback legal and third-party workstreams to signing. - Support portfolio companies post-close on performance monitoring, value creation initiatives, and add-on acquisitions. What We're Looking For Must-haves - 2 to 5 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or growth equity with software or technology coverage preferred. - Strong LBO modeling and financial analysis skills with comfort across earn-outs, DDTLs, and seller notes. - Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent processes with attention to detail under time pressure. - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to draft IC memos and present to senior stakeholders. - Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a related analytical discipline. Nice-to-haves - Experience evaluating vertical SaaS or operational software businesses and fluency in ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, and churn. - Lower middle market transaction experience on leaner deal teams. - Buy-side diligence coordination across QoE vendors, outside counsel, and technology advisors. Who You Are You qualify deals against a thesis before committing team resources, not after. You build models that hold up under stress-testing and flag the assumptions most likely to break. You engage directly with founders and management teams and read them well. You hold a point of view in IC and update it when the data changes. You take ownership of workstreams end-to-end without waiting for handoffs. You think about what happens after close, not just what gets you to signing. You are genuinely curious about how operationally critical software builds and sustains moats. What We Offer - Performance-based bonus tied to deal outcomes and meaningful carry participation - Hybrid role based in Canada - Full investment lifecycle ownership from day one with a clear pathway to Principal and Partner track

Members on our team have: - Founded and exited successful companies - Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic - Won IMO and IOI gold medals - Published field-defining papers We’re backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.
